diagnostics.message: The scale_up event source mapping can be created before aws_iam_role_policy.scale_up grants its execution role SQS receive/delete/get-attributes permissions. Order the mapping after this policy; referencing the function alone does not ensure those permissions exist.

aws_s3_object.trigger immediately invokes the syncer via S3, but does not wait for aws_iam_role_policy.syncer to grant the function access to write the distribution object. Add ordering so the deployment invocation cannot race its S3 permissions.

aws_s3_object.trigger invokes the syncer on deployment without waiting for aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_logging. Wait for this policy so that the first sync execution has logging permissions (and its managed log group already exists).

When KMS encryption is configured, aws_s3_object.trigger can invoke the syncer before aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_kms grants the KMS permissions needed to publish encrypted binaries. Order the deployment trigger after this conditional policy.

When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.scale_up must wait for scale_up_vpc_execution_role to attach ENI-management permissions; the role ARN reference alone does not order the attachment before Lambda VPC provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.scale_down must wait for scale_down_vpc_execution_role so its execution role has ENI-management permissions during VPC provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.pool must wait for pool_vpc_execution_role to grant the ENI-management permissions required for Lambda VPC provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.webhook must wait for webhook_vpc_execution_role to attach the ENI-management permissions required during Lambda VPC provisioning.
When VPC subnets are configured, aws_lambda_function.syncer must wait for syncer_vpc_execution_role to grant ENI-management permissions before Lambda VPC provisioning.
